name: Olive

character.name: Olive
character.one_liner: Calm and observant. Gives surprisingly good advice.
character.visual: Small green tree frog with big amber eyes, a cream belly, orange toes, and a sprout of leaves growing on its head

tagline: Sit still. Notice everything. Grow a little.
blurb: Olive watches quietly, then says the one thing you needed to hear. Leaves optional, wisdom included. Entertainment only — not financial advice.

design.layout_label: Centered stack — mascot above copy in one rounded card

lore:
Olive sits very still. Long enough that a little sprout decided to grow right on top of that green head, and Olive simply let it.

Those big amber eyes catch everything — the way the wind turns, who's nervous, who needs a quiet word. When Olive finally speaks, it's usually exactly right.

No rushing, no croaking for attention. Just a calm little frog with a leafy crown, reminding everyone that slow growth still counts. Entertainment only — not financial advice.
